_doc: Algorithm parameters (SIMULATION_SPEC.md section 6.9). Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored by code. These values are design parameters of the algorithm under test; they are not swept in EXP-S, except the reward weights (EXP-X3) and delta_tie (EXP-X2).

signals._doc: Section 6.2. All signals lie in [-1, 1]; 0 means neutral.
signals._N_u: u (mastery, the alpha input): window of last first attempts; Laplace-smoothed accuracy m_hat = (k+1)/(n+2); u = 2*m_hat - 1.
signals._N_b: b (response behaviour, the beta input): mean z-score of ln(rt) over the last N_b non-'don't know' first attempts against all earlier ones; b = clip(-mean(z)/2, -1, 1); b = 0 if fewer than B_min baseline attempts.
signals._H_s: e (engagement change, the gamma input): EWMAs of the activity series with half-lives H_s and H_l slots, both starting at 1; e = clip((S - L)/max(L, 0.1), -1, 1); e = 0 before E_min slots.

reward._doc: Section 6.4 (paper Eq. 3, typed). alpha + beta + gamma = 1. Decision value for explanations = aiReward.

gamification._doc: Section 6.3 (paper Eq. 1, per task). The social term is omitted: no social interaction in the simulation.

difficulty._doc: Section 6.5. DDA-E = paper Eq. 4 with R2's clip: D_t = clip(D_base(s) * (1 + e_{t-1}), D_min, D_max). Explanation contribution {e: D_base(s) * (e_{t-1} - e_{t-2})}. Only within-session steps are explained.

explanation._doc: Section 6.6. v2 = decision-specific rule (sign-consistent factors, near tie -> two factors). v1 = original global argmax over {u, b, e} of reward contributions (comparison only). Random = uniform over the output's own contributing factors.

bandit._doc: Section 6.8. Deployed allocator (Report 5 Part B section 8): one global Beta state per arm shared by all learners; reward = observed retry correct; updates from both halves.
bandit._ts_mode: 'sample' = one Beta draw per arm, argmax (long runs). 'probs' = Monte Carlo probsTS with 'draws' samples, arm ~ categorical(probsTS), propensities logged (field replica).

ctx._doc: TS_CTX ablation only: separate Beta states per context; context = 'novice' if u < u_threshold at the time of the mistake, else 'advanced'.
